verses.original: וַיְבִיאֵ֖נִי אֶל־ הַהֵיכָ֑ל וַיָּ֣מָד אֶת־ הָאֵילִ֗ים שֵׁשׁ־ אַמּ֨וֹת רֹ֧חַב־ מִפּ֛וֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־ אַמּֽוֹת־ רֹ֥חַב מִפּ֖וֹ רֹ֥חַב הָאֹֽהֶל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇî·’ê·nî ’el- ha·hê·ḵāl way·yā·māḏ ’eṯ- hā·’ê·lîm šêš- ’am·mō·wṯ rō·ḥaḇ- mip·pōw wə·šêš- ’am·mō·wṯ- rō·ḥaḇ mip·pōw rō·ḥaḇ hā·’ō·hel
verses.literal: Then the man brought me into the outer sanctuary and measured the side pillars to be six cubits wide on each side . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Levou-me ao templo e mediu as ombreiras: seis cúbitos de largura duma parte e seis cúbitos de largura da outra, que era a largura do tabernáculo.

verses.original: וְרֹ֣חַב הַפֶּתַח֮ עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּוֹת֒ וְכִתְפ֣וֹת הַפֶּ֔תַח חָמֵ֤שׁ אַמּוֹת֙ מִפּ֔וֹ וְחָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִפּ֑וֹ וַיָּ֤מָד אָרְכּוֹ֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֖חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rō·ḥaḇ hap·pe·ṯaḥ ‘e·śer ’am·mō·wṯ wə·ḵiṯ·p̄ō·wṯ hap·pe·ṯaḥ ḥā·mêš ’am·mō·wṯ mip·pōw wə·ḥā·mêš ’am·mō·wṯ mip·pōw way·yā·māḏ ’ā·rə·kōw ’ar·bā·‘îm ’am·māh wə·rō·ḥaḇ ‘eś·rîm ’am·māh
verses.literal: The width of the entrance was ten cubits and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on each side He also measured the length of the outer sanctuary to be forty cubits and the width to be twenty cubits
verses.literalPt: A largura da entrada era de dez cúbitos; e os lados da entrada: cinco cúbitos duma parte e cinco cúbitos da outra. Ele mediu o seu comprimento: era de quarenta cúbitos, e a sua largura: de vinte cúbitos.

verses.original: וּבָ֣א לִפְנִ֔ימָה וַיָּ֥מָד אֵֽיל־ הַפֶּ֖תַח שְׁתַּ֣יִם אַמּ֑וֹת וְהַפֶּ֙תַח֙ שֵׁ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת וְרֹ֥חַב הַפֶּ֖תַח שֶׁ֥בַע אַמּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā lip̄·nî·māh way·yā·māḏ ’êl- hap·pe·ṯaḥ šə·ta·yim ’am·mō·wṯ wə·hap·pe·ṯaḥ šêš ’am·mō·wṯ wə·rō·ḥaḇ hap·pe·ṯaḥ še·ḇa‘ ’am·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: And he went into the inner sanctuary and measured the side pillars at the entrance to be two cubits wide The entrance was six cubits wide and the walls on each side were seven cubits wide
verses.literalPt: Então, entrou para dentro e mediu cada ombreira da entrada: dois cúbitos; e a entrada: seis cúbitos; e a largura da entrada: sete cúbitos.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨מָד אֶת־ אָרְכּ֜וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּ֗ה וְרֹ֛חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה אֶל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַֽהֵיכָ֑ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י זֶ֖ה קֹ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māḏ ’eṯ- ’ā·rə·kōw ‘eś·rîm ’am·māh wə·rō·ḥaḇ ‘eś·rîm ’am·māh ’el- pə·nê ha·hê·ḵāl way·yō·mer ’ê·lay zeh qō·ḏeš haq·qo·ḏā·šîm
verses.literal: Then he measured the room adjacent to . . . the inner sanctuary to be twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide And he said to me This is the Most Holy Place . . .
verses.literalPt: Mediu o seu comprimento: vinte cúbitos; e a largura: vinte cúbitos, diante do templo; e disse-me: Este é o Santo dos Santos.

verses.original: וַיָּ֥מָד קִֽיר־ הַבַּ֖יִת שֵׁ֣שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת וְרֹ֣חַב הַצֵּלָע֩ אַרְבַּ֨ע אַמּ֜וֹת סָבִ֧יב׀ סָבִ֛יב לַבַּ֖יִת סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māḏ qîr- hab·ba·yiṯ šêš ’am·mō·wṯ wə·rō·ḥaḇ haṣ·ṣê·lā‘ ’ar·ba‘ ’am·mō·wṯ sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ lab·ba·yiṯ sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Next he measured the wall of the temple to be six cubits thick and the width of each side room around . . . the temple was four cubits
verses.literalPt: Então, mediu a parede da casa: seis cúbitos; e a largura de cada câmara lateral: quatro cúbitos, ao redor da casa de todos os lados.

verses.original: וְהַצְּלָעוֹת֩ צֵלָ֨ע אֶל־ צֵלָ֜ע שָׁל֧וֹשׁ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים פְּעָמִ֗ים וּ֠בָאוֹת בַּקִּ֨יר אֲשֶׁר־ לַבַּ֧יִת לַצְּלָע֛וֹת סָבִ֥יב׀ סָבִ֖יב לִהְי֣וֹת אֲחוּזִ֑ים וְלֹֽא־ יִהְי֥וּ אֲחוּזִ֖ים בְּקִ֥יר הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haṣ·ṣə·lā·‘ō·wṯ ṣê·lā‘ ’el- ṣê·lā‘ šā·lō·wōš ū·šə·lō·šîm pə·‘ā·mîm ū·ḇā·’ō·wṯ baq·qîr ’ă·šer- lab·ba·yiṯ laṣ·ṣə·lā·‘ō·wṯ sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ lih·yō·wṯ ’ă·ḥū·zîm wə·lō- yih·yū ’ă·ḥū·zîm bə·qîr hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: The side rooms were arranged one above another in three levels of thirty rooms each . . . There were ledges all around . . . the wall of the temple to serve as supports for the side rooms so that the supports would not be fastened into the wall of the temple itself
verses.literalPt: As câmaras eram de três andares, câmara sobre câmara, e trinta em cada andar; e, na parede que pertencia à casa, entravam para as câmaras laterais ao redor, a fim de pegarem nela e não pegarem na parede da casa.

verses.original: וְֽרָחֲבָ֡ה וְֽנָסְבָה֩ לְמַ֨עְלָה לְמַ֜עְלָה לַצְּלָע֗וֹת כִּ֣י מֽוּסַב־ הַ֠בַּיִת לְמַ֨עְלָה לְמַ֜עְלָה סָבִ֤יב׀ סָבִיב֙ לַבַּ֔יִת עַל־ כֵּ֥ן רֹֽחַב־ לַבַּ֖יִת לְמָ֑עְלָה וְכֵ֧ן הַתַּחְתּוֹנָ֛ה יַעֲלֶ֥ה עַל־ הָעֶלְיוֹנָ֖ה לַתִּיכוֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·ḥă·ḇāh wə·nā·sə·ḇāh lə·ma‘·lāh lə·ma‘·lāh laṣ·ṣə·lā·‘ō·wṯ kî mū·saḇ- hab·ba·yiṯ lə·ma‘·lāh lə·ma‘·lāh sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ lab·ba·yiṯ ‘al- kên rō·ḥaḇ- lab·ba·yiṯ lə·mā·‘ə·lāh wə·ḵên hat·taḥ·tō·w·nāh ya·‘ă·leh ‘al- hā·‘el·yō·w·nāh lat·tî·ḵō·w·nāh
verses.literal: The side rooms . . . surrounding the temple widened at each successive level . . . . . . . . . because the structure surrounding . . . the temple ascended by stages corresponding to . . . the narrowing of the temple wall . . . as it rose upward And so a stairway went up from the lowest story to the highest through the middle one
verses.literalPt: As câmaras laterais eram mais largas à proporção que iam rodeando a casa mais e mais para cima ( o rodear da casa ia subindo mais e mais alto ao redor da casa); por isso, a largura da casa se aumentava para cima; e assim, da câmara mais baixa, se subia pela da média até a câmara mais alta.

verses.original: וְרָאִ֧יתִי לַבַּ֛יִת גֹּ֖בַהּ סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב מְיֻסְּדוֹת הַצְּלָעוֹת֙ מְל֣וֹ הַקָּנֶ֔ה שֵׁ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת אַצִּֽילָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’î·ṯî lab·ba·yiṯ gō·ḇah sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ mə·yus·sə·ḏōṯ haṣ·ṣə·lā·‘ō·wṯ mə·lōw haq·qā·neh šêš ’am·mō·wṯ ’aṣ·ṣî·lāh
verses.literal: I saw that the temple had a raised base all around it forming the foundation of the side rooms It was the full length of a rod six long cubits
verses.literalPt: Vi também que a casa tinha ao redor um pavimento levantado; as câmaras laterais tinham fundamentos da medida duma cana inteira, de seis cúbitos até a juntura.

verses.original: רֹ֣חַב הַקִּ֧יר אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ לַצֵּלָ֛ע אֶל־ הַח֖וּץ חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר מֻנָּ֔ח בֵּ֥ית צְלָע֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: rō·ḥaḇ haq·qîr ’ăšer- laṣ·ṣê·lā‘ ’el- ha·ḥūṣ ḥā·mêš ’am·mō·wṯ wa·’ă·šer mun·nāḥ bêṯ ṣə·lā·‘ō·wṯ ’ă·šer lab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: The outer wall of the side rooms was five cubits thick and the open area between the side rooms of the temple
verses.literalPt: A grossura da parede, que era para as câmaras laterais, do lado de fora, era de cinco cúbitos; e o que sobrava era o lugar das câmaras laterais, que pertenciam à casa.

verses.original: וּבֵ֨ין הַלְּשָׁכ֜וֹת רֹ֣חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֛ה סָבִ֥יב לַבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֥יב׀ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇên hal·lə·šā·ḵō·wṯ rō·ḥaḇ ‘eś·rîm ’am·māh sā·ḇîḇ lab·ba·yiṯ sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: and the outer chambers was twenty cubits wide all around . . . . . . the temple
verses.literalPt: Entre as câmaras, havia a largura de vinte cúbitos ao redor da casa, por todos os lados.

verses.original: וּפֶ֤תַח הַצֵּלָע֙ לַמֻּנָּ֔ח פֶּ֤תַח אֶחָד֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן וּפֶ֥תַח אֶחָ֖ד לַדָּר֑וֹם וְרֹ֙חַב֙ מְק֣וֹם הַמֻּנָּ֔ח חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת סָבִ֥יב׀ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄e·ṯaḥ haṣ·ṣê·lā‘ lam·mun·nāḥ pe·ṯaḥ ’e·ḥāḏ de·reḵ haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn ū·p̄e·ṯaḥ ’e·ḥāḏ lad·dā·rō·wm wə·rō·ḥaḇ mə·qō·wm ham·mun·nāḥ ḥā·mêš ’am·mō·wṯ sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: The side rooms opened into this area . . . with one entrance on the north . . . and another on the south The open area . . . was five cubits wide all around
verses.literalPt: As portas das câmaras laterais olham para o lugar que sobrava: uma porta para o norte e outra porta para o sul; e a largura do lugar que sobrava era de cinco cúbitos ao redor.

verses.original: וְהַבִּנְיָ֡ן אֲשֶׁר֩ אֶל־ פְּנֵ֨י הַגִּזְרָ֜ה פְּאַ֣ת דֶּֽרֶךְ־ הַיָּ֗ם רֹ֚חַב שִׁבְעִ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְקִ֧יר הַבִּנְיָ֛ן חָֽמֵשׁ־ אַמּ֥וֹת רֹ֖חַב סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב וְאָרְכּ֖וֹ תִּשְׁעִ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hab·bin·yān ’ă·šer ’el- pə·nê hag·giz·rāh pə·’aṯ de·reḵ- hay·yām rō·ḥaḇ šiḇ·‘îm ’am·māh wə·qîr hab·bin·yān ḥā·mêš- ’am·mō·wṯ rō·ḥaḇ sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ wə·’ā·rə·kōw tiš·‘îm ’am·māh
verses.literal: Now the building that faced . . . the temple courtyard . . . on the west was seventy cubits wide and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around with a length of ninety cubits
verses.literalPt: O edifício que estava em frente do lugar separado ao lado que olha para o ocidente tinha setenta cúbitos de largura; e a parede do edifício tinha cinco cúbitos de grossura ao redor, e o seu comprimento era de noventa cúbitos.

verses.original: וּמָדַ֣ד אֶת־ הַבַּ֔יִת אֹ֖רֶךְ מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֑ה וְהַגִּזְרָ֤ה וְהַבִּנְיָה֙ וְקִ֣ירוֹתֶ֔יהָ אֹ֖רֶךְ מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·ḏaḏ ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ ’ō·reḵ mê·’āh ’am·māh wə·hag·giz·rāh wə·hab·bin·yāh wə·qî·rō·w·ṯe·hā ’ō·reḵ mê·’āh ’am·māh
verses.literal: Then he measured the temple to be a hundred cubits long and the temple courtyard and the building with its walls were also a hundred cubits long
verses.literalPt: Assim, mediu a casa: cem cúbitos de comprido; o lugar separado, e o edifício, e as suas paredes: cem cúbitos de comprido;

verses.original: וְרֹחַב֩ פְּנֵ֨י הַבַּ֧יִת וְהַגִּזְרָ֛ה לַקָּדִ֖ים מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rō·ḥaḇ pə·nê hab·ba·yiṯ wə·hag·giz·rāh laq·qā·ḏîm mê·’āh ’am·māh
verses.literal: The width of the temple courtyard on the east including the front of the temple was a hundred cubits
verses.literalPt: também a largura da dianteira da casa e do lugar separado que olha para o oriente: cem cúbitos.

verses.original: וּמָדַ֣ד אֹֽרֶךְ־ הַ֠בִּנְיָן אֶל־ פְּנֵ֨י הַגִּזְרָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל־ אַחֲרֶ֧יהָ וְאַתּוּקֵיהָא מִפּ֥וֹ וּמִפּ֖וֹ מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֑ה וְהַֽהֵיכָל֙ הַפְּנִימִ֔י וְאֻֽלַמֵּ֖י הֶחָצֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·ḏaḏ ’ō·reḵ- hab·bin·yān ’el- pə·nê hag·giz·rāh ’ă·šer ‘al- ’a·ḥă·re·hā wə·ʾat·tū·qē·hå̄ mip·pōw ū·mip·pōw mê·’āh ’am·māh wə·ha·hê·ḵāl hap·pə·nî·mî wə·’u·lam·mê he·ḥā·ṣêr
verses.literal: Next he measured the length of the building facing . . . the temple courtyard at the rear of the temple including its galleries on each side . . . it was a hundred cubits The outer sanctuary the inner sanctuary and the porticoes facing the court
verses.literalPt: Mediu o comprimento do edifício, em frente do lugar separado que estava por detrás dele, e as suas galerias duma e da outra parte: cem cúbitos; e o templo, interior, e os vestíbulos do átrio.

verses.original: הַסִּפִּ֡ים וְהַחַלּוֹנִ֣ים הָ֠אֲטֻמוֹת וְהָאַתִּיקִ֤ים׀ סָבִיב֙ לִשְׁלָשְׁתָּ֔ם נֶ֧גֶד הַסַּ֛ף שְׂחִ֥יף עֵ֖ץ סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב וְהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ עַד־ הַֽחַלֹּנ֔וֹת וְהַֽחַלֹּנ֖וֹת מְכֻסּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: has·sip·pîm wə·ha·ḥal·lō·w·nîm hā·’ă·ṭu·mō·wṯ wə·hā·’at·tî·qîm sā·ḇîḇ liš·lā·šə·tām ne·ḡeḏ has·sap̄ śə·ḥîp̄ ‘êṣ sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ wə·hā·’ā·reṣ ‘aḏ- ha·ḥal·lō·nō·wṯ wə·ha·ḥal·lō·nō·wṯ mə·ḵus·sō·wṯ
verses.literal: as well as the thresholds and the beveled windows and the galleries all around with their three levels opposite the threshold were overlaid with wood on all sides . . . They were paneled from the ground to the windows and the windows were covered
verses.literalPt: Os limiares, e as janelas fechadas, e as galerias ao redor nos três andares, defronte do limiar forrado de madeira ao redor, e desde o chão até as janelas (Ora, as janelas estavam cobertas);

verses.original: עַל־ מֵעַ֣ל הַפֶּ֡תַח וְעַד־ הַבַּיִת֩ הַפְּנִימִ֨י וְלַח֜וּץ וְאֶל־ כָּל־ הַקִּ֨יר סָבִ֧יב׀ סָבִ֛יב בַּפְּנִימִ֥י וּבַחִיצ֖וֹן מִדּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- mê·‘al hap·pe·ṯaḥ wə·‘aḏ- hab·ba·yiṯ hap·pə·nî·mî wə·la·ḥūṣ wə·’el- kāl- haq·qîr sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ bap·pə·nî·mî ū·ḇa·ḥî·ṣō·wn mid·dō·wṯ
verses.literal: In the space above . . . the outside of the entrance to the inner sanctuary on all the walls spaced evenly around . . . the inner and outer sanctuary
verses.literalPt: até o espaço por cima da porta, sim, até a casa interior, e pelo lado de fora, e por toda a parede de dentro e de fora, tudo por medida.

verses.original: וְעָשׂ֥וּי כְּרוּבִ֖ים וְתִֽמֹרִ֑ים וְתִֽמֹרָה֙ בֵּין־ כְּר֣וּב לִכְר֔וּב וּשְׁנַ֥יִם פָּנִ֖ים לַכְּרֽוּב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śui kə·rū·ḇîm wə·ṯi·mō·rîm wə·ṯi·mō·rāh bên- kə·rūḇ liḵ·rūḇ ū·šə·na·yim pā·nîm lak·kə·rūḇ
verses.literal: were alternating . . . . . . carved cherubim and palm trees Each cherub had two faces . . .
verses.literalPt: Fizeram-se querubins e palmeiras (entre querubim e querubim havia uma palmeira), e cada querubim tinha dois rostos,

verses.original: וּפְנֵ֨י אָדָ֤ם אֶל־ הַתִּֽמֹרָה֙ מִפּ֔וֹ וּפְנֵֽי־ כְפִ֥יר אֶל־ הַתִּֽמֹרָ֖ה מִפּ֑וֹ עָשׂ֥וּי אֶל־ כָּל־ הַבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֥יב׀ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·nê ’ā·ḏām ’el- hat·ti·mō·rāh mip·pōw ū·p̄ə·nê- ḵə·p̄îr ’el- hat·ti·mō·rāh mip·pōw ‘ā·śui ’el- kāl- hab·ba·yiṯ sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: the face of a man was toward the palm tree on one side and the face of a young lion was toward the palm tree on the other side They were carved all the way around . . . . . . . . . the temple
verses.literalPt: de sorte que o rosto de homem olhava para a palmeira duma parte, e o rosto de leão novo, para a palmeira da outra; assim se fez pela casa toda ao redor.

verses.original: מֵהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ עַד־ מֵעַ֣ל הַפֶּ֔תַח הַכְּרוּבִ֥ים וְהַתִּֽמֹרִ֖ים עֲשׂוּיִ֑ם וְקִ֖יר הַׄהֵׄיׄכָֽׄלׄ׃
verses.transliteration: mê·hā·’ā·reṣ ‘aḏ- mê·‘al hap·pe·ṯaḥ hak·kə·rū·ḇîm wə·hat·ti·mō·rîm ‘ă·śū·yim wə·qîr ha·hē·ḵå̄l
verses.literal: Cherubim and palm trees were carved on the wall of the outer sanctuary from the floor to the space above the entrance
verses.literalPt: Desde o chão até por cima da porta, estavam feitos querubins e palmeiras; assim era a parede do templo.

verses.original: הַֽהֵיכָ֖ל מְזוּזַ֣ת רְבֻעָ֑ה וּפְנֵ֣י הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ הַמַּרְאֶ֖ה כַּמַּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hê·ḵāl mə·zū·zaṯ rə·ḇu·‘āh ū·p̄ə·nê haq·qō·ḏeš ham·mar·’eh kam·mar·’eh
verses.literal: The outer sanctuary had a rectangular doorframe and the doorframe of the sanctuary was similar
verses.literalPt: Quanto ao templo, as ombreiras das portas eram quadradas; e, quanto à dianteira do santuário, a sua aparência era como a aparência do templo.

verses.original: הַמִּזְבֵּ֡חַ עֵ֣ץ שָׁלוֹשׁ֩ אַמּ֨וֹת גָּבֹ֜הַּ וְאָרְכּ֣וֹ שְׁתַּֽיִם־ אַמּ֗וֹת וּמִקְצֹֽעוֹתָיו֙ ל֔וֹ וְאָרְכּ֥וֹ וְקִֽירֹתָ֖יו עֵ֑ץ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלַ֔י זֶ֚ה הַשֻּׁלְחָ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ham·miz·bê·aḥ ‘êṣ šā·lō·wōš ’am·mō·wṯ gā·ḇō·ah wə·’ā·rə·kōw šə·ta·yim- ’am·mō·wṯ ū·miq·ṣō·‘ō·w·ṯāw lōw wə·’ā·rə·kōw wə·qî·rō·ṯāw ‘êṣ way·ḏab·bêr ’ê·lay zeh haš·šul·ḥān ’ă·šer lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: There was an altar of wood three cubits high and two cubits square Its corners base and sides were of wood And the man told me This is the table that is before the LORD
verses.literalPt: De madeira era o altar, de três cúbitos de altura, e o seu comprimento, de dois cúbitos; e os seus cantos, e o seu comprimento, e as suas paredes eram de madeira; e disse-me: Esta é a mesa que está diante de Jeová.

verses.original: וּשְׁתַּ֧יִם דְּלָת֛וֹת לַֽהֵיכָ֖ל וְלַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·ta·yim də·lā·ṯō·wṯ la·hê·ḵāl wə·laq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: Both the outer sanctuary and the inner sanctuary had double doors
verses.literalPt: O templo e o santuário tinham duas portas.

verses.original: וּשְׁתַּ֥יִם דְּלָת֖וֹת לַדְּלָת֑וֹת שְׁ֚תַּיִם מוּסַבּ֣וֹת דְּלָת֔וֹת שְׁ֚תַּיִם לְדֶ֣לֶת אֶחָ֔ת וּשְׁתֵּ֥י דְלָת֖וֹת לָאַחֶֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·ta·yim də·lā·ṯō·wṯ lad·də·lā·ṯō·wṯ šə·ta·yim mū·sab·bō·wṯ də·lā·ṯō·wṯ šə·ta·yim lə·ḏe·leṯ ’e·ḥāṯ ū·šə·tê ḏə·lā·ṯō·wṯ lā·’a·ḥe·reṯ
verses.literal: and each door had two swinging panels There were two panels for one door and two . . . for the other
verses.literalPt: As portas tinham cada uma dois batentes, dois batentes que viravam; dois batentes para uma porta e dois batentes para a outra.

verses.original: וַעֲשׂוּיָ֨ה אֲלֵיהֶ֜ן אֶל־ דַּלְת֤וֹת הַֽהֵיכָל֙ כְּרוּבִ֣ים וְתִֽמֹרִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשׂוּיִ֖ם לַקִּיר֑וֹת וְעָ֥ב עֵ֛ץ אֶל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאוּלָ֖ם מֵהַחֽוּץ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·śū·yāh ’ă·lê·hen ’el- dal·ṯō·wṯ ha·hê·ḵāl kə·rū·ḇîm wə·ṯi·mō·rîm ka·’ă·šer ‘ă·śū·yim laq·qî·rō·wṯ wə·‘āḇ ‘êṣ ’el- pə·nê hā·’ū·lām mê·ha·ḥūṣ
verses.literal: Cherubim and palm trees like those on the walls were carved on the doors of the outer sanctuary and there was a wooden canopy outside on the front of the portico
verses.literalPt: Nelas, a saber, nas portas do templo, foram feitos querubins e palmeiras, como se fizeram nas paredes; e havia grossas traves de madeira na dianteira do vestíbulo pelo lado de fora.

verses.original: וְחַלּוֹנִ֨ים אֲטֻמ֤וֹת וְתִֽמֹרִים֙ מִפּ֣וֹ וּמִפּ֔וֹ אֶל־ כִּתְפ֖וֹת הָֽאוּלָ֑ם וְצַלְע֥וֹת הַבַּ֖יִת וְהָעֻבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥal·lō·w·nîm ’ă·ṭu·mō·wṯ wə·ṯi·mō·rîm mip·pōw ū·mip·pōw ’el- kiṯ·p̄ō·wṯ hā·’ū·lām wə·ṣal·‘ō·wṯ hab·ba·yiṯ wə·hā·‘ub·bîm
verses.literal: There were beveled windows and palm trees . . . on the sidewalls of the portico The side rooms of the temple also had canopies
verses.literalPt: Havia janelas fechadas e palmeiras duma e da outra parte pelos lados do vestíbulo; assim eram as câmaras laterais da casa e as grossas traves.
